# The Mercury

> Local news, sports, and community information for Pottstown and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania.

The Mercury is the primary news source for Pottstown, PA and surrounding Montgomery County communities. The site covers breaking news, local sports, weather, and community events across the region including areas like Pottsgrove, Boyertown, Spring-Ford, and other townships.

## Key Topics

- Montgomery County
- Pottstown, PA
- Breaking News
- Local News
- Sports Roundup
- Community Events
- Crime Reports
- Weather Alerts
- Pottsgrove
- Boyertown
- Spring-Ford School Board
- Route 422
- Subscription
- Account Management

## Core News & Information

- [The Mercury Homepage](https://www.pottsmerc.com): Main news portal featuring breaking news, local coverage, sports, weather, and events for Pottstown and Montgomery County

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports in Montgomery County](https://www.pottsmerc.com/sports): Sports news and analysis covering Philadelphia teams and Montgomery County high school athletics

## Subscription & Account Management

- [Subscription Panel](https://checkout.pottsmerc.com): Subscription management, account registration, login, password reset, and email verification portal
